oracle.binary64_replay: host libm values are measured and checked against fixed certified bounds but excluded from canonical JSON; only outcome/index/count and the bounds are canonical
oracle.implementation: Python standard library Decimal analytic-gradient face BFGS after deterministic coefficient/omega basin grid
oracle.initial_variance: full-sample mean normalized squared residual, independent of parameters
oracle.name: independent_decimal_garch11_gaussian_qml
oracle.normalization: demean, divide residuals by max absolute residual, form binary64 squares from logarithm differences
oracle.objective: 0.5 * sum(log(h[t]) + e[t]^2 / h[t]); Gaussian constant and n*log(scale) omitted
oracle.open_boundary_rule: omega/initial_variance and every free coefficient/slack must exceed 1e-18; transformed-gradient saturation at an open boundary is never convergence
oracle.recurrence: h[t] = omega + alpha * e[t-1]^2 + beta * h[t-1]
oracle.selection: independently grid interior, alpha=0, beta=0, and alpha=beta=0 faces; refine each face and prefer a lower-dimensional objective-equivalent attained KKT point
